prerequisite.reason: Local/value implementation must use the post-parameter native audit as its capacity baseline.

local_record.mutability_rule: derive from the declaration form; fail closed on an unrepresented declaration kind
local_record.frame_slot_rule: deterministic declaration order within owner function; zero based
local_record.reason_for_packing: One record per local avoids five or six independently initialized arrays, reducing self-source value pressure.

value_namespace.instruction_constant_and_result_ids: allocated monotonically from first_non_storage_value_id in deterministic lowering order
value_namespace.no_reuse_rule: bootstrap IR v2 does not recycle value IDs
value_namespace.ownership_rule: every value ID records exactly one owner_function_id and one definition kind

required_local_verifier_checks: local record is nonzero for every declared local
name identity is in the bounded identifier domain
type ID is a valid S3 type identity
frame slot is unique within the owner function
local value ID is inside the reserved local-storage range
local value IDs do not collide with parameter IDs
no local record exceeds selected capacity

next_def_use_contract.local_reference: resolves to local storage value ID
next_def_use_contract.store: records destination local value ID and source value ID
next_def_use_contract.arithmetic_or_comparison: records operand value IDs and a new result value ID
next_def_use_contract.call: records ordered argument value IDs and result value ID or explicit no-result sentinel
next_def_use_contract.terminator: records condition or return value ID when required

capacity_policy.rule: Use the actual parameter-candidate native audit as the new baseline. Do not expand any pool from a static projection alone.

forbidden_shortcuts: source regex or pattern matching for codegen
